name: The Crucifixion
overview: The Crucifixion stands at the heart of God's redemptive plan, as demonstrated in Scripture where Jesus is nailed to the cross at Calvary, fulfilling prophetic words and enduring separation from the Father in our place. Despite the agony expressed in Psalms 22:1, Christ’s love is evident in His prayer for forgiveness for His persecutors and His declaration that the work was finished (Luke 23:34; John 19:30). This sacrificial act reveals God’s immense love, giving His only Son so that all who believe may receive eternal life (John 3:16).
